merchant.name: Merchant
lines: Welcome, traveler. Fine goods and rumors alike are for sale here.
The wilderness lies just beyond the village — stock up on food and water before you set out.
Mind the mud pits. Safe travels!

guard.name: Guard
lines: Halt! ...Oh, it's you. Welcome to the village.
Good timing — the village elder has a favor to ask of you.
Go have a word with the elder; he's not far to the east.

elder.name: Elder
lines: Child, you've come. The guard has already told me about you.
The monsters out there carry gems. Follow the path south to the Dungeon and bring me three.
Beware those monsters, and don't bite off more than you can chew. Off you go!

weapon_merchant.name: Weapon Merchant
lines: Welcome, warrior. Only the finest iron is sold here.
Blades, shields, and armor — pick something that fits your hand.
One more layer of protection on the battlefield is one more chance to live.

clothing_merchant.name: Clothing Merchant
lines: Welcome, customer. This shop deals in clothing and accessories.
From fine robes and cloaks down to earrings and tails — we have it all.
Pick something you like and wear it proudly all year!
